# Stone Line

> Stone Line is a premium natural stone company based in Cristești, Mureș County, Romania (operated by Davalex SRL). With over 20 years of experience, it sources, fabricates, and installs natural stone — marble, granite, travertine, andesite, and slate — for residential and commercial projects, alongside restoration and specialist consultation services. The site is bilingual (Romanian primary, English secondary).

## Company
- Legal entity: Davalex SRL, trading as Stone Line
- Address: Str. Principală 563B, Cristești, Mureș, Romania
- Contact: [Contact page](https://stone-line.ro/contact) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/contact-en)) — WhatsApp: +40 365 402 379
- Hours: Mon–Thu 10:00–17:00, Fri 10:00–16:00, closed weekends

- [Montaj piatră naturală / Natural stone installation](https://stone-line.ro/montaj-piatra-naturala) ([EN](https://stone-line.ro/montaj-piatra-naturala-en))
